posts.text:
Thursday, Nov 26: Toronto's streetcars lost 900 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 509 Harbourfront eastbound. A typical 2.2 km trip lost 7 min (usually 6).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch westbound, 13 min over 8.0 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Thursday's slowest spot: Southbound on York St, at Adelaide St West.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 15 s here (usually 82 s). Across 146 trips, that adds up to 5.5 hours.
posts.alt: 3D map of York St around Adelaide St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Adelaide St West is highlighted, adding up to about 2 min 15 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: York St southbound, at Adelaide St West
shot.sub: Thursday, Nov 26: 2 min 15 s lost per streetcar · 146 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Thursday, Nov 26: 505 Dundas. 1 in 11 trips (45) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave (westbound, 36), instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 505 Dundas route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave, gives how many westbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Thursday, Nov 26: westbound at Strachan Ave & Fleet St.

39% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 298 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Strachan Ave & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the westbound approach reads 39% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Thursday, Nov 26: at the busiest moment (4:50 pm), 151 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 98% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,195 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 90% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Thursday, Nov 26, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 151 streetcars at 4:50 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 98% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Thursday, Nov 26: RONCESVALLES AVE AT QUEEN ST WEST NORTH SIDE (504 King westbound).

A car was due about every 10 min, so the average wait should have been about 5. It was 11.6: more than double.

Chance of waiting over 10 min: 37%. On schedule: 2%.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around RONCESVALLES AVE AT QUEEN ST WEST NORTH SIDE in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads a 11.6 minute average wait, 6.7 more than on schedule, with a 37% chance of waiting over 10 minutes against 2% on schedule, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
